summary: follow a line, tape, lane marking, painted path, visual guide, floor track with the mobile robot
description: Commands the robot to follow a visible line or floor marking for a bounded duration. Command format: 'line_follow <duration_s>' where duration_s limits the behavior. Output reports line detection quality, lateral error, speed, line lost, timeout, and completion. Report when line following starts, if the line is lost, and final result.
